description: Mixed terminators retain candidate-sized family summaries through nested owners (engine §4.1).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text $c:candidate %conditions $c.without-elision.matches(rival)
%rule candidate c B
%rule c X c [+T] | Y c [+U] | X [+T] | Y [+U]
%rule rival r B
%rule r X r [+T] | X s [+T] | Y r [+U] | Y s [+U] | X [+T] | Y [+U]
%rule s X r [+T] | X s [+T] | Y r [+U] | Y s [+U] | X [+T] | Y [+U]
%rule fam r
